blind.description: A stylized rock cave mouth or natural stone archway constructed from blocky, faceted boulders stacked together. The surfaces are solid and continuous with hand-painted earthy brown-grey rock textures and patches of green moss on upper facets. The model rests directly on the floor with a flat bottom edge, with no extra plinth or floating elements.
blind.from_above: A thick, curved crescent or horseshoe-shaped cluster of segmented rocky blocks surrounding a hollow recessed entrance.
blind.black_or_unpainted_areas: none (interior cave cavity has dark shadowed depth)
blind.height_vs_figure: About three-quarters the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 4 to 4.5 ft tall) and roughly 4 to 5 ft wide.

notes: Footprint is squarer and slightly lower than catalog target, but reads naturally as a rocky cave mound.
